messages:
Maya Patel: hi team! Maya here, joining product infra as a backend engineer. first day and very excited :smile: pronouns she/her. quick note: I'll be focused on deployment tooling and the CI pipeline. any must-do items for day one?
Devon Li: welcome Maya :tada: i'm your onboarding buddy — slack DM me anytime. Day 1: confirm laptop & Okta, access to GitHub org, and the infra dev cluster. Also join the 2pm "swap tickets" session with the infra crew.
Maya Patel: thanks Devon! where do I grab the bootstrap scripts? macbook M1 btw.
Devon Li: use the repo at https://github.com/redwood-inference/dev-setup. run `./bootstrap.sh --m1` if you have an M1. add your SSH key to your GitHub profile and request access to the infra repo.
Samir Rao: hey Maya, welcome aboard. I'll set up a 30-min sync tomorrow to go over team priorities. no rush today — focus on access and the quickstart. feel free to ask CI stuff in #eng-ci.
welcome-bot: [system] :tada: Maya Patel joined #new-hires. Please check pinned resources and complete the "Intro survey".
people-ops-bot: [system] Hi Maya — please upload a photo for the directory and confirm your emergency contact info: https://hr.redwood.example/profile
Maya Patel: got the links. one more: who handles desk/parking for on-site folks?
Devon Li: people-ops handles that — ping @people-ops in Slack or use the office booking form.
Maya Patel: perfect. also curious if the team has any rituals (standups, pairing days, etc.)
Samir Rao: standup 10:15am daily, pairing Thursdays, and design reviews Wednesdays. we do quarterly "ship days" and occasional retro lunches.
Maya Patel: sounds great. last funny question — team snack preferences? I'm allergic to peanuts.
Devon Li: we keep snacks peanut-free in the main kitchen, but call out allergies in the office form. also team loves iced matcha.
Maya Patel: noted. thanks y'all — excited to get started :rocket:
Devon Li: see you at the 2pm session. I'll DM you the onboarding checklist and a short map of repos.
people-ops-bot: [system] Onboarding checklist: accounts created (1/6). Next: equipment pickup.
Maya Patel: adding these notes to my todo. appreciate the warm welcome!
